description: Repairs r-par-1/fold-decimal-sum-groups and r-par-1/create-fold2: the 28-digit and small-scale witnesses were not stored. Asks what Sum returns (Field type, size, Precision, Scale, value, or error and call) over columns that can hold the witnesses: FD0 (DECIMAL(28,0); 28 nines, 1, minus 28 nines; 28 nines and 1; 1, 1) and FD20 (DECIMAL(28,20); 1.00000000000000000001 and 1; 0.1, 0.2, 0.3; 0.5, 0.5), per group, over all rows and as GROUP BY g. The stored values are read first. Fixture r-fix-expr-sql-par is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field. Each statement is preceded by a marker (a DROP TABLE of a table that does not exist, which always fails), so DBEngine.Errors read after the statement shows that statement's own failure or the marker's, never an older one. Where Field Precision and Scale are read, the recordset is first positioned on its first row (MoveFirst) and DecimalPlaces is not read.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-expr-sql probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
